args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent previously healthy version in production. Post-rollback health check confirms the service is healthy with error rate back down to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Both actions are complete:

**Rollback:** checkout-api has been rolled back from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0** (the most recent previously healthy production release) in all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Verified post-rollback that the service is healthy, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0" — which paged the on-call engineer. The summary describes the health check failures in all production regions, the rollback action taken, and the confirmed recovery.
